clips.title: The story
paras: Master Gadrin is an elderly jungle troll and a venerable witch doctor of the Darkspear tribe, currently residing in Sen'jin Village. Having once trained the tribe's priests and mages alongside the renegade witch doctor Zalazane, he now coordinates efforts to aid his displaced people and break the dark curse gripping their stolen home on the Echo Isles.

Long before the Darkspear arrived on Kalimdor, Master Gadrin served as a witch doctor of his tribe in their ancestral South Seas islands, where he guided the mystical training of generations of Darkspear trolls.

When the Darkspear settled the Echo Isles alongside the Horde, Gadrin and the young witch doctor Zalazane led the mystical training of the tribe's priests and mages together. Tragically, Zalazane succumbed to madness, intoxicated by the dark voodoo forces he sought to wield. The rogue practitioner enslaved his brethren's minds and drove Vol'jin and the uncorrupted Darkspear onto the mainland of Durotar. Now based in Sen'jin Village, Gadrin carries the personal sorrow of seeing a former companion become a tyrannical monster, working tirelessly to lay slain tribesfolk to rest and end Zalazane's reign.

Beyond the crisis on the Echo Isles, Gadrin stands as one of the Horde's greatest living authorities on troll spiritualism and loa lore. Scholars, shamans, and even the Royal Apothecary Society seek his insight on arcane and alchemical mysteries. When strange threats like the Burning Blade brush against Durotar, or distant researchers require forgotten rituals—such as deciphering ancient tablets in Zul'Farrak to invoke Shadra the spider loa—it is Gadrin who possesses the knowledge to craft the necessary bindings.
